Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — returns n constrained to [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats bytes as B/KB/MB/GB with one decimal place (using 1024-byte units)
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces whitespace runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric/dash characters

All are exported from their respective modules.
